cat > /workspace/tmp/test_census.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json, base64, struct, plistlib
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from harness import *

HOME='2001:db8:1:1200::'
def h(n): return HOME+'::%s'%n if False else '2001:db8:1:1200::%s'%n

# --- revision reconciliation ----------------------------------------
rows=[
    icmp('r1',1,5,'home',1,'0/i1',h('1'),h('1'),'echo'),
    icmp('r1',2,15,'home',1,'0/i1',h('1'),h('2'),'echo'),   # higher revision wins
]
job=base_job(leases=[lease()],queries=[10,20],captures=[capture(rows)])
out,_=run(job)
s10,s20=out['snapshots']
check('rev ledger q10', s10['ledger']=={'live':1,'deleted':0,'conflict':0}, s10['ledger'])
check('rev internal q10', s10['leases'][0]['internal']==[h('1')], s10['leases'][0]['internal'])
check('rev ledger q20', s20['ledger']=={'live':1,'deleted':0,'conflict':0}, s20['ledger'])
check('rev internal q20', s20['leases'][0]['internal']==[h('2')], s20['leases'][0]['internal'])

# identical copies count once, different content at same revision -> conflict
rows=[
    icmp('r1',1,5,'home',1,'0/i1',h('1'),h('1'),'echo'),
    icmp('r1',1,6,'home',1,'0/i1',h('1'),h('1'),'echo'),    # identical copy
]
job['captures']=[capture(rows)]
out,_=run(job)
check('copies once', out['snapshots'][0]['ledger']=={'live':1,'deleted':0,'conflict':0}, out['snapshots'][0]['ledger'])

rows=[
    icmp('r1',1,5,'home',1,'0/i1',h('1'),h('1'),'echo'),
    icmp('r1',1,6,'home',1,'0/i1',h('1'),h('2'),'echo'),    # different content, same revision
]
job['captures']=[capture(rows)]
out,_=run(job)
check('conflict', out['snapshots'][0]['ledger']=={'live':0,'deleted':0,'conflict':1}, out['snapshots'][0]['ledger'])
check('conflict no internal', out['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['internal']==[], out['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0])

# delete tombstone and resurrection
rows=[
    icmp('r1',1,5,'home',1,'0/i1',h('1'),h('1'),'echo'),
    delete('r1','icmp',2,15),
    icmp('r1',3,25,'home',1,'0/i1',h('1'),h('1'),'echo'),
]
job=base_job(leases=[lease()],queries=[10,20,30],captures=[capture(rows)])
out,_=run(job)
ledgers=[s['ledger'] for s in out['snapshots']]
check('tombstone ledger', ledgers==[{'live':1,'deleted':0,'conflict':0},
                                    {'live':0,'deleted':1,'conflict':0},
                                    {'live':1,'deleted':0,'conflict':0}], ledgers)

# --- lease states ----------------------------------------------------
# canary echo -> aliased
rows=[icmp('r1',1,5,'home',1,'0/c','2001:db8:1:1200:e22c:bc0:ce5b:ffd',
          '2001:db8:1:1200:e22c:bc0:ce5b:ffd','echo')]
job=base_job(leases=[lease()],queries=[10],captures=[capture(rows)])
out,_=run(job)
l=out['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]
check('alias state', l['state']=='alias', l)
check('alias empty clean', l['internal']==[] and l['external']==[], l)
check('alias unresolved all', l['unresolved']==[h('1'),h('2')], l['unresolved'])

# external responder + conflict
rows=[
    icmp('r1',1,5,'home',1,'0/i1',h('1'),h('1'),'echo'),
    icmp('r2',1,5,'home',1,'0/i2',h('2'),h('1'),'echo'),   # external answers ::1 as well
]
job['captures']=[capture(rows)]
out,_=run(job)
l=out['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]
check('conflict state', l['state']=='conflict', l)
check('conflict list', l['conflicts']==[h('1')], l)
check('conflict clean empty', l['internal']==[] and l['external']==[], l)
check('conflict unresolved all', l['unresolved']==[h('1'),h('2')], l)

# inactive lease
rows=[icmp('r1',1,5,'home',1,'0/i1',h('1'),h('1'),'echo')]
job=base_job(leases=[lease(start=0,end=100)],queries=[200],captures=[capture(rows)])
out,_=run(job)
l=out['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]
check('inactive state', l['state']=='inactive', l)
check('inactive empty', l['internal']==[] and l['external']==[] and l['unresolved']==[] and l['conflicts']==[], l)
check('inactive ledger counts live', out['snapshots'][0]['ledger']['live']==1, out['snapshots'][0]['ledger'])
check('inactive services empty', l['services'][0]['internal_open']==[] and l['services'][0]['protocol_errors']==0, l['services'])

# timeout and self error add nothing
rows=[
    icmp('r1',1,5,'home',1,'0/i1',h('1'),'','timeout'),
    icmp('r2',1,5,'home',1,'0/i2',h('2'),h('2'),'error'),
]
job=base_job(leases=[lease()],queries=[10],captures=[capture(rows)])
out,_=run(job)
l=out['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]
check('timeout/error no roles', l['internal']==[] and l['external']==[], l)
check('usable state', l['state']=='usable', l)

# --- application census ---------------------------------------------
rows=[
    icmp('r1',1,5,'home',1,'0/i1',h('1'),h('1'),'echo'),
    app('a1',1,6,'home',2,h('1'),'web',0,'open',''),
]
job=base_job(leases=[lease()],queries=[10],captures=[capture(rows)])
out,_=run(job)
l=out['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]
check('app eligible', out['snapshots'][0]['unbound_applications']==0, out['snapshots'][0])
check('app internal open', l['services'][0]['internal_open']==[h('1')], l['services'][0])
check('app internal_only empty (no E)', l['services'][0]['internal_only']==[], l['services'][0])

# causality: event before the witness -> unbound
rows=[
    icmp('r1',1,5,'home',5,'0/i1',h('1'),h('1'),'echo'),
    app('a1',1,6,'home',2,h('1'),'web',0,'open',''),
]
job['captures']=[capture(rows)]
out,_=run(job)
check('causality unbound', out['snapshots'][0]['unbound_applications']==1, out['snapshots'][0])
check('causality no open', out['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['services'][0]['internal_open']==[], out['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['services'][0])

# max attempt decides; earlier attempts ignored
rows=[
    icmp('r1',1,5,'home',1,'0/i1',h('1'),h('1'),'echo'),
    app('a1',1,6,'home',2,h('1'),'web',0,'closed',''),
    app('a2',1,6,'home',2,h('1'),'web',1,'open',''),
]
job['captures']=[capture(rows)]
out,_=run(job)
s=out['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['services'][0]
check('max attempt open', s['internal_open']==[h('1')] and s['internal_closed']==[], s)

# mixed latest attempts -> unknown
rows=[
    icmp('r1',1,5,'home',1,'0/i1',h('1'),h('1'),'echo'),
    app('a1',1,6,'home',2,h('1'),'web',1,'closed',''),
    app('a2',1,6,'home',2,h('1'),'web',1,'open',''),
]
job['captures']=[capture(rows)]
out,_=run(job)
s=out['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['services'][0]
check('mixed unknown', s['internal_open']==[] and s['internal_closed']==[], s)

# external role + internal_only
rows=[
    icmp('r1',1,5,'home',1,'0/i1',h('1'),h('1'),'echo'),
    icmp('r2',1,5,'home',1,'0/i2',h('2'),h('9'),'echo'),      # external responder ::9
    app('a1',1,6,'home',2,h('1'),'web',0,'open',''),
    app('a2',1,6,'home',2,h('9'),'web',0,'closed',''),
]
job['captures']=[capture(rows)]
out,_=run(job)
s=out['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['services'][0]
check('external closed', s['external_closed']==[h('9')], s)
check('internal_only set', s['internal_only']==[h('1')], s)
check('external open empty', s['external_open']==[], s)

# protocol errors: adb open with malformed payload
def adb_packet(command,arg0,arg1,body):
    total=sum(body)&0xffffffff
    return struct.pack('<6I',command,arg0,arg1,len(body),total,command^0xffffffff)+body
rows=[
    icmp('r1',1,5,'home',1,'0/i1',h('1'),h('1'),'echo'),
    app('a1',1,6,'home',2,h('1'),'adb',0,'open',b64(b'garbage')),
]
job=base_job(leases=[lease()],queries=[10],
             services=[{'id':'adb','kind':'adb'}],captures=[capture(rows)])
out,_=run(job)
s=out['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['services'][0]
check('protocol error counted', s['protocol_errors']==1, s)
check('protocol error unknown', s['internal_open']==[], s)

# adb valid open -> open
rows=[
    icmp('r1',1,5,'home',1,'0/i1',h('1'),h('1'),'echo'),
    app('a1',1,6,'home',2,h('1'),'adb',0,'open',b64(adb_packet(0x4e584e43,0x01000000,4096,b'host::zgrab2'))),
]
job['captures']=[capture(rows)]
out,_=run(job)
s=out['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['services'][0]
check('adb open', s['internal_open']==[h('1')] and s['protocol_errors']==0, s)

# differing adb signatures disagree -> unknown, both counted? (one malformed)
rows=[
    icmp('r1',1,5,'home',1,'0/i1',h('1'),h('1'),'echo'),
    app('a1',1,6,'home',2,h('1'),'adb',0,'open',b64(adb_packet(0x4e584e43,0x01000000,4096,b'a'))),
    app('a2',1,6,'home',2,h('1'),'adb',0,'open',b64(adb_packet(0x4e584e43,0x02000000,4096,b'b'))),
]
job['captures']=[capture(rows)]
out,_=run(job)
s=out['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['services'][0]
check('adb disagree unknown', s['internal_open']==[] and s['protocol_errors']==0, s)

# earlier malformed attempt does not count as protocol error
rows=[
    icmp('r1',1,5,'home',1,'0/i1',h('1'),h('1'),'echo'),
    app('a1',1,6,'home',2,h('1'),'adb',0,'open',b64(b'garbage')),
    app('a2',1,6,'home',2,h('1'),'adb',1,'open',b64(adb_packet(0x4e584e43,0x01000000,4096,b'a'))),
]
job['captures']=[capture(rows)]
out,_=run(job)
s=out['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['services'][0]
check('earlier malformed ignored', s['protocol_errors']==0 and s['internal_open']==[h('1')], s)
print('failures',globals().get('FAILURES',0))
PYEOF
